columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Unique invoice key (one row per invoice after dedup).

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: Customer account id; an account may have many invoices.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: Original invoice currency before FX normalization.

columns.name: amount_usd
columns.description: As-billed invoice amount, FX-normalized to USD, signed (refunds negative).

columns.name: status
columns.description: Canonical payment status. Only paid/refunded count as revenue.

columns.name: signup_date
columns.description: When the account first signed up.

columns.name: invoice_date
columns.description: When this invoice was issued; drives time windows.

columns.name: churned
columns.description: Whether the account has since churned (cumulative snapshot).

columns.name: support_tickets
columns.description: Support tickets opened by the account.

columns.name: mrr_usd
columns.description: Per-invoice monthly recurring revenue in USD = list_price[plan]*seats*(1-discount_pct/100).

rules.description: De-duplicate: keep one record per invoice_id (near-duplicate resolution).
Normalize categorical values (status, plan, billing_cycle, payment_method, churned) to canonical forms.
FX-normalize amounts to USD and derive mrr_usd.
Parse mixed date formats to ISO DATE.
